title: Only finitely many visits, almost everywhere
promptMarkdown: For measurable sets $E_n\subset\mathbb R$, suppose $\sum_nm(E_n)<\infty$. Show that the set of points belonging to infinitely many $E_n$ has measure zero. Give a sequence with $\sum_nm(E_n)=\infty$ for which this conclusion fails, and another for which it still holds.
hintLadder: Write “infinitely many” as a countable intersection of tail unions.
Bound the measure by every tail of the convergent series.
